bagPolicy.summary: Permitted bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Medical items are allowed after inspection.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The West Surface Lot is the closest option and is complimentary for volleyball, women’s basketball, wrestling, and gymnastics. Accessible parking is in Lot 58/ADA Blue Lot east of the arena.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Set your rideshare destination to 600 East Veterans Way, Tempe, AZ 85281. Drop-off is near the main entrance or a nearby accessible area. Follow posted signs and event staff directions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Multiple stands on the main concourse sell food, beverages, and alcohol.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available throughout the arena, and accessible parking is in Lot 58/ADA Blue Lot. Guests may contact Athletic Operations and Facilities for accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after a ticket has been scanned.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For Sun Devils games, the ticket office is on the west side of Desert Financial Arena and opens one hour before game time. Phone sales at 480-727-0000 run weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: Doors open 60 minutes before game time. Men’s basketball uses the north, southeast, and west entrances; volleyball uses the west and east entrances, and the south entrance is student-only.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
